title: Desk Training Notes: Converting a Farm Real Estate Loan to Another FarmLand Product
content:
**The rule.** At the member's request, registered as a rate conversion request naming the product to convert into, a Farm Real Estate Loans mortgage may be converted to another farm real estate product without refinancing, keeping its mortgage, maturity and amortization. A conversion may take effect only while the loan is in active status. A conversion may take effect no earlier than the product's conversion spacing in calendar months after the loan closed or was last converted, counted from the later of the closing date and the last conversion date to the same day of the target month (the last day of that month when the day does not exist), that day itself qualifying. The product converted into must be one of the current product's conversion targets, and no installment may be past due. On conversion the new rate is set under the contract rate-setting rules, the installment is re-amortised over the remaining amortization, a new loan year count starts for the prepayment fee schedule, and a conversion fee of the product's conversion fee percentage of the principal balance, but not less than the product's minimum conversion fee, is assessed in place of any prepayment fee.

## Questions the rule answers

**What has to be on the record before a conversion takes effect?**
The loan's own system record must show it in active status (a loan in nonaccrual or any other status cannot convert), the spacing date must have been reached, the target must be on the current product's conversion list, and no installment may be past due. The request itself is registered as a rate conversion request naming the product to convert into.

**From which date is the spacing counted?**
From the later of the closing date and the last conversion date, both read from the loan record.

**How is the target month's day found?**
The spacing is counted to the same day of the target month; when that month has no such day, its last day is used. That day itself qualifies.

**What does the loan keep, and what changes?**
It keeps its mortgage, its maturity and its amortization. The new rate is set under the contract rate-setting rules for the product converted into, the installment is re-amortised over the remaining amortization, and the prepayment fee schedule's loan year count starts again from the conversion date.

**What fee is charged?**
A conversion fee of the product's conversion fee percentage of the principal balance, rounded to cents, but not less than the product's minimum conversion fee — assessed in place of any prepayment fee.

## Spacing boundary (hypothetical dates)

| Loan closed or last converted | Spacing | Target day | Effective date requested | Qualifies |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 31 August 2026 | 6 months | 28 February 2027 (no 31st) | 28 February 2027 | yes |
| 31 August 2026 | 6 months | 28 February 2027 | 27 February 2027 | no |
| 15 March 2026 | 12 months | 15 March 2027 | 15 March 2027 | yes |
| 15 March 2026 | 12 months | 15 March 2027 | 14 March 2027 | no |

**Fee illustration (hypothetical).** Principal balance USD 260000.00 on a product with a 0.25 percent fee and a USD 500 minimum: 0.25 percent is USD 650.00, above the minimum, so the fee is USD 650.00.
